scope: Deterministic classical relative-phase tracking with phenomenological actuator gain degradation; no quantum correction or universal fatigue law
freeze: Local prospective specification, not independent preregistration
numerical_lock_criterion: absolute late-window mean phase drift < 0.001 rad/s and late-window phase range < 0.01 rad; finite-time diagnostic, not proof
comparison: Standard constant-gain Adler equation (alpha=0) versus a specified two-state gain-degradation extension. The extension is itself a conventional nonlinear control model, not an established SEFI-specific law.
evaluation: All detunings and time steps reported. Analytical equilibrium and stability conditions checked independently by finite-difference Jacobians and numerical trajectories. No parameter fit or superiority claim.
